title: Print a greeting
prompt:
Make the program print exactly:

```
Hello, PyForge
```

Case and spelling matter — output comparison is exact.

hints.text: The built-in function that writes to the screen is `print`.
Text values go inside quotes: `"like this"`.
Call a function by writing its name followed by parentheses containing the argument.
The shape is: `print("...")` — with the exact greeting inside.

solution.explanation: `print` writes its argument to standard output, then adds a newline. The string literal is the argument.
